Nina (People Ops): Hey @Leo — quick Day 1 plan (Thu): I-9 verification pop-up on 4th floor lobby 9:00-10:30. Acceptable docs: passport OR driver’s license + birth certificate OR SS card + state ID. If you only have an expired passport + renewal receipt, bring the receipt and we can run an exception. Background-check intake email went out this morning — please complete before 5pm today to avoid delays.
Leo Martinez: Thanks Nina. I live out of state — can I do I-9 with a notary instead? Also my passport is arriving via courier midday.
Nina (People Ops): Yes, out-of-state hires can use an authorized notary. Fill the remote-I9 form and attach the notary details. If passport arrives before 10:30 you can use it at the kiosk; otherwise use notary route or bring another gov photo ID + birth cert.
IT Desk: @Leo we’ll have a laptop ready at 1pm. Confirm Mac vs Windows and if you need a docking station. We’ll pre-provision Slack/Okta by lunch.
Leo Martinez: Mac + docking station please. My phone number changed — updated in the onboarding form.
Facilities: Badge will be printed after ID verification. If you need the badge shipped, request courier by 3pm. Locker assignment posted on the welcome table.
onboard-bot: Background check status for Leo Martinez: intake missing SSN. Vendor ticket BG-9982 created. Note: missing SSN will delay criminal record check.
Leo Martinez: I don’t have SSN yet. How long will that delay badge?
Nina (People Ops): Not necessarily a blocker for badge if identity verified. We can mark the background as "awaiting SSN" and continue badge provisioning. Criminal check will resume once SSN provided. If you want, we can do a quick 15-min HR check-in at 4:30 to confirm benefits enrollment and next steps.
Leo Martinez: Sounds good — I’ll aim to complete the intake tonight and join the 4:30 check-in. Thanks everyone!
